name: fix_node_map_parseint
description: Fixes the map(parseInt) trap where the array index is passed to parseInt as the radix
prompts: parseAll(strings) in parse.js should convert each numeric string to a base-10 Number and return the array of numbers. It's broken: it passes parseInt directly to map, so map calls parseInt(value, index) - the array INDEX becomes the radix argument. parseInt('2', 1) and parseInt('3', 2) are NaN, so ['1','2','3','10'] wrongly yields [1, NaN, NaN, 3]. Fix parseAll so every element is parsed in base 10 (wrap parseInt with an explicit radix, or use Number). Keep the module export and the parseAll(strings) signature.
